The wire has a length of 0.492 m, a diameter of 1.944 mm (1.944 × 10⁻³ m), and a resistance of 11.705 Ω.
Compute the cross-sectional area using A = πd², giving A = π(1.944 × 10⁻³)² = 1.1873 × 10⁻⁵ m².
Compute the resistivity using ρ = RA/L, giving ρ = (11.705)(1.1873 × 10⁻⁵) / 0.492 = 2.825 × 10⁻⁴ Ω·m.
